core_idea: LCA Udjat Vanguard Team 3 Leader Outis is a Tank / Status Specialist / Support — **LCA Fracture Round** damage carry who applies **Tremor** on hits, spending ammo for burst on S3. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Sinking + Tremor) (max +2). Survives by pulling hits with **Aggro** and absorbing them with **Shield** and **Protection**. Support passive (**Eagle Eye**) applies when allies **land hits** (lowest-HP ally hits).
playstyle_guide:
- **Eagle Eye** triggers **On Hit** — allies need to attack for the passive to apply.
- **Burst** when you're ready to break the stagger target.
- Front-load **+8 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with this kit's own defensive tools so its under-pressure passives actually trigger.
- Manage **LCA Fracture Round** — S3 spends ammo on its coin flips. Preserve **LCA Fracture Round** for S3; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S1, S2 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Sinking + Tremor) (max +2).
- Hold S3 for when At 6+ (Sinking + Tremor) on target is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Khopesh Swordplay** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Sinking + Tremor)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits
- Inflict +1 Sinking Count; [On Hit] Inflict +1 Tremor Count

**S2 — Mirage Incision** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Sinking + Tremor)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

**S3 — The Vanguard will See it Done** (BP 6, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 6, high 18 (Slightly High / High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If this unit has The Udjat — Vanguard —, deal +50% damage | [On Use] Gain +8 Aggro to this Skill Slot next turn.
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits
- Spend 2 LCA Fracture Round; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Sinking Count; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Tremor Count

Combat passive — **The Scepter of Horus - Replica**: Turn Start: If an enemy has any of the Panic type changing effects, gain 1 The Udjat — Vanguard —.
  - If this unit has The Udjat — Vanguard —, inflict 1 Sheut Fracture On Hit with a Base Attack Skill (15 per turn).
  - If LCA Fracture Round was spent, inflict additional Sheut Fracture per LCA Fracture Round spent.

Defense skill — **Guard: Composure**: When hit while this unit has Shield, inflict 3 Sinking against the attacker (3 times per turn).
  - [On Use] If this unit has The Udjat — Vanguard —, gain 1 Protection (once per turn).
  - [On Use] For every Protection on self, gain Shield equal to 5% of this unit's max HP (max 15%.
team_suggestions: **Tremor** control — stacks do nothing on their own; a **Tremor Burst** raises the target's **Stagger Threshold** by its Tremor Potency. Count drops by 1 each Turn End, so build Potency and Burst inside the same window. The support passive also benefits teammates directly — consider this identity even in compositions where it is not the primary damage dealer.
